title: For self-lending pairs rewards will be stuck
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  For self-lending pods, the paired LP token of the pod is a fToken, which is a share of a lending pair.  In the `AutoCompoundingPodLp`, it converts the reward token into the paired LP token. However for self-lending pods, instead of converting to the fToken, it converts to the underlying token since it is a more liquid asset.
